title: Discover App
description: Finds Apps at a domain or HTTPS link. Returns OpenBot App Protocol candidates, configuration requirements and provenance (where each candidate came from). It does not add a connection, authorize an account or index a service.

title: Attach File
description: Attaches one ready file as a user history item without starting a Turn. The Chat must be idle with no queued input. Reuse requestId to recover the same attachment.

title: Send Bot Message
description: Sends a message to your Chat with this Bot. OpenBot makes the Chat the first time. When the Bot is free, the message starts a Turn at once. When the Bot works for you, it reads the message at its next step. You need `bots.delegate` on the Bot.

title: Send Message
description: Sends a message to a direct Chat, a task Chat or a live Chat. In a task Chat, the Bot reads it as a message from you. In a live Chat, the message waits until a Live session is open.

title: List Chats
description: Lists your Chats. Without `kind`, it lists direct Chats, channel Chats and live Chats.

title: Get Chat
description: Returns the Chat, its current Turn and its latest response. Reading never starts work.

title: Update Chat
description: Changes the mode, the model or the plan approval of the Chat. A new model also needs `models.use`.

title: Delete Chat
description: Deletes the history of a direct Chat, a channel Chat or a live Chat. It stops the running Turn and cancels the work that the Chat gave away first. The next message starts an empty Chat.

title: Chat Items
description: Lists the Items of the Chat, newest first. Send `next` as `before` to read older Items.

title: Interrupt Chat
description: Stops the running Turn. The work that the Chat gave to Bots goes on, unless `delegations` is true.

title: Update Chat Todos
description: Replaces the todo list of the Chat. The Bot also changes it with its todo tool.

title: Chat Delegations
description: Lists the work that this Chat gave to Bots, with its status and result.

title: Chat Confessions
description: Lists what the Bot said with `confide` in this Chat, and the answers that it got. The Bot uses it to talk about how its work goes. See the client guide before you show it to people.

title: Chat Enrichments
description: Lists what the memory Bot added to the input of each Turn, and the Bot memory entries that it used.

title: Create Live Chat
description: Makes a new live Chat of yours with this Bot. Then open its Live WebSocket. You need `bots.delegate` on the Bot and `models.use` on the Live model.

title: Connect Live
description: Opens the Live WebSocket of a live Chat. Each thing the person says starts a Turn, and the Bot answers with sound and text. Turns use the shared execution engine. Sound stays on the open connection. A browser must connect from the public origin.

title: Upload File
description: Uploads one file through OpenBot, as `multipart/form-data` with the field `file`. The file is ready at once. The platform can turn this way off.

title: Create Upload
description: Makes a pending file and a signed address in object storage. The client puts the bytes there itself, then completes the file. The platform can turn this way off.

title: Complete Upload
description: Checks that the bytes are in object storage with the right size, and makes the file ready.

title: List Files
description: Lists the files that you may read, newest first.

title: Get File Content
description: Gives the bytes of a ready file.

title: Delete File
description: Deletes a file now. Chats that used it keep their text, but the model no longer sees the file.

title: Get Delegation
description: Reads one piece of work that a Bot gave away, from one of your Chats.

title: Cancel Delegation
description: Asks the execution to stop this work and its child work. Observe the execution until its resources are released.

title: List Bots
description: Lists the Bots that the caller can use: their own Bots and the shared Bots. With `bot`, it lists the Bots that this Bot owns.

title: Bot Memory
description: Reads the entries of the Bot memory that the caller may see: entries for the caller, for a Channel group that the caller is in, or for everyone who uses the Bot, in the organization of the caller. Nobody can read the memory about another person.

title: Update Bot Memory
description: Remembers something about the caller, or takes back what the caller gave to an entry.

title: Bot Memory Log
description: Lists the changes that touch entries that the caller may see.

title: Purge Bot Memory
description: Removes every entry with one tag of OpenBot, like `from:<userId>` or `chat:<id>`, without showing them. It needs `bots.write` on a Bot that is not linked.

title: Memory Bot
description: Reads the settings of the memory Bot that keeps the memory of this Bot. It needs `bots.write` on a Bot that is not linked.

title: Update Memory Bot
description: Changes the rules, the concurrency and the budget of the memory Bot. It needs `bots.write` on a Bot that is not linked.

title: Create Rule
description: Adds a Rule that the caller wrote for this Bot. A Rule from a person is active at once.

title: Update Rule
description: Changes the text of a Rule, confirms a proposed Rule, or retires a Rule.

title: Revoke Grant
description: Revokes a Grant and every Grant that came from it.

title: List Bot Members
description: Lists the people who use this Bot in their own organizations. It needs `bots.share`.

title: Remove Bot Member
description: Takes a person off this Bot. Their linked Bot stops working at once.

title: Create Bot Invitation
description: Invites a person by email, or makes an invitation link, to use this Bot. It needs `bots.share`. Only a lasting top Bot can be shared.

title: Bot Invitation Secret
description: Reads the secret and the URL of an invitation link again, for example to print its QR code again.

title: Revoke Bot Invitation
description: Takes back a pending invitation. People who accepted it stay members.

title: Accept Bot Invitation
description: Accepts an email invitation (`invitation`) or an invitation link (`secret`). It makes a linked Bot in your organization and gives it back. When you already use the Bot, it gives back your linked Bot.

title: List Requests
description: Lists the requests that wait for the caller, or that the caller answered.

title: Resolve Request
description: Saves one decision and returns its execution receipt. The workflow sends the result to the Chat.

title: Update Member Settings
description: Changes your settings. Send the `version` that you read as `expectedVersion`. If they changed since then, the change fails with SettingsConflict.

title: List Triggers
description: Lists the triggers that the caller can read: their own and the shared ones.

title: Update Trigger
description: Changes a trigger and clears needsAuthorization. The caller becomes its actor, so the new tasks work for the caller.

title: Set Trigger Webhook
description: Makes a new webhook secret. The old secret stops working. The caller becomes the actor of the trigger.

title: Create Channel
description: Saves a Channel and starts its configuration execution. The caller becomes its actor. Read executionId to check registration.

title: Update Channel
description: Changes a Channel. The caller becomes its actor and clears needsAuthorization.

title: Delete Channel
description: Stops Channel work, then deletes the Channel and its links. Read the returned execution to wait for release. Its Chats stay.

title: Set Channel Secret
description: Makes a new signing secret for a custom Channel. The old secret stops working.

title: Delete Channel Identity
description: Unlinks a person. The bot asks them to link again.

title: Get Channel Link
description: Shows who a link code is for, so the person can check it before they accept.

title: Accept Channel Link
description: Links the person on the platform to the caller. A code works only once.

title: List Computer Providers
description: Lists the Computer providers that the caller can use: their own and the shared ones.

title: Create Computer Provider
description: Adds an account at a Computer provider. OpenBot checks the key with the provider first.

title: Delete Computer Provider
description: Deletes a Computer provider. It fails while Computers still use it.

title: List Computers
description: Lists the Computers that the caller can use: their own and the shared ones. With `bot`, it lists only the Computers that this Bot has the right to use.

title: Create Computer
description: Accepts a command to create a Computer and returns its execution receipt. Reuse the command key after a lost reply. A connector Computer stays offline until it connects.

title: Delete Computer
description: Accepts a command to delete a Computer and its sandbox, files and Bot grants. Follow its execution receipt for the result. A lost provider reply waits for a decision.

title: List Computer Bots
description: Lists the Bots that have the right to use a Computer.

title: Grant Computer
description: Gives a Bot the right to use a Computer. The caller must be able to use the Computer and to change the Bot.

title: Revoke Computer
description: Takes the right to use a Computer away from a Bot. The Computer stays.

title: List Computer Usage
description: Lists the times when a Computer ran, newest first. The provider bills them. OpenBot only records them.

title: Pause Computer
description: Accepts a command to pause a Computer and returns its execution receipt. The provider keeps its files. E2B also keeps its memory and running programs.

title: Set Connector Token
description: Makes a new token for the connector of a connector Computer. The old token stops working, and its connection closes.

title: Exec
description: Starts a shell command and waits up to yieldTimeMs for it. When it still runs, the answer has a session ID for more input and output. A paused Computer resumes first.

title: Write Stdin
description: Sends text to the stdin of a session, and gives the output since the last call.

title: Close Session
description: Stops the command of a session, and gives its last output.

title: Write File
description: Writes a file. OpenBot makes the missing directories.

title: Remove File
description: Removes a file, or a directory with everything in it.

title: Open Port
description: Gives a port a public HTTPS address.

title: Use Desktop
description: Does the actions in order, then takes a screenshot.

title: Stream Desktop
description: Gives an address where a person can watch and use the desktop.

title: Get Computer Pairing
description: Shows which machine a pairing code is for, so the person can check it before they approve.

title: Approve Computer Pairing
description: Approves a machine. OpenBot creates a connector Computer for it, and the machine gets its token on its next poll. The Computer belongs to the caller, or to the organization when `shared` is true. When the same machine pairs again, OpenBot keeps its Computer and only changes the token. Only a person can approve.

title: Deny Computer Pairing
description: Denies a machine. Its pairing ends at once.

title: List Secret Providers
description: Lists the secret providers that the caller can use: their own and the shared ones.

title: Create Secret Provider
description: Adds an account at a secret provider. OpenBot checks the token with the provider first.

title: Delete Secret Provider
description: Deletes a secret provider. It fails while Vault items still read from it.

title: List Vaults
description: Lists the Vaults that the caller can use: their own and the shared ones.

title: Delete Vault
description: Deletes a Vault, its items and the rights of all Bots to use it. The secret providers keep their secrets.

title: Create Vault Item
description: Adds an item. For an item of a secret provider, the caller must be able to use the provider, and OpenBot reads the item once to check that its fields are there.

title: List Vault Bots
description: Lists the Bots that have the right to use a Vault.

title: Grant Vault
description: Gives a Bot the right to use every item of a Vault in Code Mode. The caller must be able to use the Vault and to change the Bot.

title: Revoke Vault
description: Takes the right to use a Vault away from a Bot.

title: Get Usage
description: Adds up the tokens and the cost of the model calls in a time range. `groupBy` is `day` when you leave it out.

title: List Usage Events
description: Lists model calls, the newest first. Send `next` as `after` to get the next page.

title: Create Budget
description: Adds a budget. Each scope can have one budget for each period.

title: List Organizations
description: Lists the organizations where you are a member. A user token sees only its own organization.

title: Create Organization
description: Creates an organization. You become its Super Administrator. The platform settings say who can do this.

title: Leave Organization
description: Leaves an organization. Your tokens in it stop working. The last active Super Administrator cannot leave. A user token can only leave its own organization.

title: List My Invitations
description: Lists the pending invitations for your verified email.

title: Accept Invitation
description: Joins the organization of the invitation. You need the session cookie, and your verified email must be the email of the invitation. An invitation to use a Bot needs `POST /v1/bot-invitations/accept` instead.

title: Decline Invitation
description: Says no to an invitation. You need the session cookie and the email of the invitation.

title: Update Platform Settings
description: Changes the platform settings. Send the `version` that you read as `expectedVersion`. Every instance uses the new settings right away. A new `publicOrigin` signs everyone out and changes the sign-in redirect URI.

title: Update Platform Organization
description: Suspends an organization or makes it active again. Nobody can use a suspended organization, and its tokens stop working.

title: Create Platform Model
description: Adds a model of the platform. `availability` says which organizations can use it. A provider must link it before anyone can call it.

title: Create Platform Model Provider
description: Adds a model provider that the platform pays for. `availability` says which organizations can use it.

title: List Platform Model Prices
description: Lists the current price of each model of a provider of the platform. Organizations pay this price with their credits.

title: Set Platform Model Price
description: Sets a new price for one model of the provider. The price applies to calls from now on. Old calls keep their cost.

title: Verify Token
description: Shows who the caller is and, for a token, its policy. Every caller can use it.

title: Get Capabilities
description: Lists the allowed actions on Organization, Member, Role, ModelProvider, Sso, AuditLog, Usage and Budget in the current organization. Uses the current member, token and platform policies. Any signed-in member can read their own result. The result helps clients show controls; each call still checks its own permissions. It does not describe rights on individual Chats, Bots or other owned resources.

title: Update Member
description: Changes the status, roles or extra policy of a member. A suspended member cannot sign in, and their tokens stop working.

title: Remove Member
description: Removes a member and revokes their tokens. If their email domain is still allowed, they join again the next time they sign in. Suspend them to keep them out.

title: List Invitations
description: Lists the invitations of the organization, newest first.

title: Create Invitation
description: Invites a person by email. They accept with `POST /v1/invitations/:invitationId/accept` after they sign in with that verified email. An invitation lasts 7 days.

title: Revoke Invitation
description: Takes back a pending invitation.

title: Update Settings
description: Changes the settings. Send the `version` that you read as `expectedVersion`. If someone changed the settings since then, the change fails with SettingsConflict. Every instance uses the new settings right away.

title: List Roles
description: Lists the built-in roles and the custom roles of the organization.

title: Create Role
description: Creates a custom role. Its policy cannot allow anything that you cannot do yourself.

title: Update Role
description: Changes a custom role. Every member with the role gets the new policy at once.

title: Delete Role
description: Deletes a custom role. It fails with RoleInUse while a member or the default roles use it.

title: List Audit Logs
description: Lists audit log entries, newest first. `actor` filters by user ID.

title: Get Model Catalog
description: Lists the models that the caller may use now, for each provider that offers them.

title: List Models
description: Lists the models of the organization. The models that the platform shares are not in the list.

title: Create Model
description: Adds a model to the organization. Link it to a provider to use it.

title: Create Model Provider
description: Adds a model provider with the API key of the organization.

title: Update Model Provider
description: Changes a model provider. The next model call uses the change.

title: List Model Prices
description: Lists the current price of each model of a provider of the organization. Usage of these models counts toward budgets, but never takes credits.

title: Set Model Price
description: Sets a new price for one model of the provider. The price applies to calls from now on. Old calls keep their cost.

title: Add Domain
description: Adds an email domain. Then add the TXT record that the answer names, and call the verify endpoint.

title: Verify Domain
description: Looks up the TXT record of the domain. When it is right, the domain becomes verified.

title: Create Sso Connection
description: Adds an OpenID Connect provider for people with an email in verified domains of the organization.
